title: Fibonacci retracements
summary: Lines at 23.6%, 38.2%, 50%, 61.8% and 78.6% of a chosen swing. A convention some traders watch for describing how deep a pullback went.
unreliableWhen: Always as a forecast: the levels depend on the anchor points chosen, and with five levels close together, many pullbacks end near one by chance. They show no predictive power on their own.
goodExample: Writing the anchor rule first, drawing from the swing low to the swing high, and noting "the pullback ended near the 50% line" as a description.
badExample: Redrawing on different swings until a level matches a turn, then calling it proof.

chart.lookFor: Use the Fibonacci tool from the low to the high of the last swing up. Note which level the pullback ended nearest, then redraw from a different low and see the lines move.
